title: Transfer proven Guava adapters to Commons Lang and ComparisonChain
description: The preceding same-source Guava run decided all five statements on both engines. Recheck all seven registered method-reference statements and direct-call twins with independent JVM witness replay, then measure the active, settled, active-null and skipped-null Guava ComparisonChain entries on both engines. Stock and image-backed Comparator profiles were recorded at opening.

steps.name: Seven callbacks and direct twins
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py qualified callbacks paired --cohort callbacks direct --require

steps.name: ComparisonChain native transfer
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py transfer callbacks native --cohort chain --require

steps.name: ComparisonChain integrated comparison
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/jbmc-fast-follow/measure.py transfer callbacks jbmc --cohort chain
